'''Sense Path''' was a [[Force power/Legends#Sense|Sense]]-based [[Force power/Legends|Force power]]. It allowed an individual to see [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] of the potential future of their actions, and whether or not their current course would lead them to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Unlike true Force visions, the visions received by the Force user were generally allegorical.
